Everything you need for your bookmarks

Full-page preservation
Unlike traditional bookmarks that often break or vanish, Linkwarden backs up every page in multiple formats, including full HTML content, ensuring you always have access to the original content.Read more
Read & Annotate
View your saved articles and bookmarks in our dedicated reader view where you can make adjustments to the font style, highlight text, and add annotations effortlessly.Read more
Automatic Organization
With AI-powered tagging and search filters, Linkwarden automatically categorizes your bookmarks so you can find exactly what you need in seconds.Read more
Sharing & Collaboration
Invite friends or teammates to contribute to your collections, ideal for research, content planning, or shared interests, and easily share them with the public.Read more

Follow RSS Feeds

Follow RSS feeds directly within your collections. New articles and updates appear just like regular saved webpages.

Upload page from Browser

When there's a webpage only you have access to, like one behind a login, you can upload a copy from your browser.

Powerful Search

You can search and filter all your curated contents across all your collections using our advanced search operators.

Browser Extension

Collect webpages directly from your browser with our open-source browser extension.

Sync with your Browser

Sync your browser bookmarks to Linkwarden using Floccus.

Bulk Actions

Edit or delete multiple items at once easily.

Import & Export

You can import and export your bookmarks easily from the settings.

Secure API Integration

Connect and secure your integrations using access tokens to create custom solutions and automate with ease.

And Many More Features...

For more information, check out our release notes in our blog. We're constantly adding new features and improvements!

Open Source Means Transparency

Linkwarden's source code is fully public, giving you visibility into how it works and confidence in how your data is handled.
